name: jupiter-docs-site
description: docs.jupiter.au: the documentation site, its PDF and the generator (@belikh/jupiter-docs). The design system is downloaded from the latest belikh/design release, never copied.

scripts.check: npm run import && node packages/docs/bin/jupiter-docs.mjs check && node packages/docs/bin/jupiter-docs.mjs build --check
scripts.build: npm run import && node packages/docs/bin/jupiter-docs.mjs build
scripts.build:site: npm run import && node packages/docs/bin/jupiter-docs.mjs build --site
scripts.build:pdf: npm run import && node packages/docs/bin/jupiter-docs.mjs build --pdf && node scripts/check-pdf-fonts.mjs dist/*.pdf
